options.description: The container: where it listens, its secret files and its database.
options.name: core

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_IDP_BASE_URL: The browser-facing https origin; a realm's issuer is <baseUrl>/realms/<realm>.
settings.name: baseUrl

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_IDP_INTERNAL_URL: The in-cluster https origin of the token, key and revocation endpoints, when it differs from baseUrl.
settings.name: internalUrl

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_IDP_HOST: Address the listener binds.
settings.name: host

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_IDP_PORT: Port the listener binds.
settings.name: port

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_IDP_TLS: Whether the service terminates TLS itself (false behind a TLS-terminating proxy).
settings.name: tls

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_IDP_TRUSTED_PROXY: Whether to honour the last x-forwarded-for / x-forwarded-proto hop (behind a reverse proxy).
settings.name: trustedProxy

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_IDP_DATA: The secret files folder (signing key, master key, TLS, admin tokens; pre-A5 data to import); defaults to data beside the code.
settings.name: dataDir

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_IDP_DATABASE_URL_FILE: The URL of the service's own Postgres database, where every record lives (a mounted secret file).
settings.name: databaseUrl

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_IDP_SECURE_COOKIE: Whether session cookies are Secure (false or 0 turns it off).
settings.name: secureCookie

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_IDP_ADMIN_TOKEN_REF: The admin API tokens (PRAGMATIC_IDP_ADMIN_TOKEN_REF names their file under the data folder secrets).
settings.name: adminToken

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_IDP_LOGIN_DIR: Folder of the built sign-in app (defaults to idp-login/dist beside the code).
settings.name: loginDir

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_IDP_CONFIGURATION_DIR: Folder of the realms' applied configuration files (one per realm).
settings.name: configurationDir

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_IDP_BOOTSTRAP_REALM_FILE: A realm configuration mounted by the deploy ({ realm, displayName, configuration }), validated at start.
settings.name: bootstrapRealm

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_IDP_SECRETS_DIR: Folder of secret files a realm's configuration names as secret:file/<name>.
settings.name: secretsDir

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_IDP_APPLICATIONS_DIR: Folder of component descriptors whose application roles every realm offers for mapping.
settings.name: applicationsDir

options.description: Token and session lifetimes of the realm.
options.name: tokens

settings.description: How long an ID token (and its access token) is valid.
settings.name: idTokenLifetime

settings.description: How long a refresh token is valid unused (each refresh rotates it).
settings.name: refreshTokenIdleLifetime

settings.description: How long refreshing can go on after the sign-in.
settings.name: refreshTokenMaxLifetime

settings.description: How long the login domain's single sign-on session re-authenticates silently.
settings.name: ssoSessionLifetime

options.description: Local accounts of the realm (email and password, provisioned by the tenant admin).
options.name: local

settings.description: Failed sign-ins of one account from one address before it locks.
settings.name: maxAttempts

settings.description: How long a locked sign-in stays locked.
settings.name: lockout

options.description: Sign in with Google (an OAuth client of the tenant's Google Cloud project).
options.name: google

settings.description: The OAuth client id.
settings.name: clientId

settings.description: The OAuth client secret.
settings.name: clientSecret

settings.description: Only accounts of this Google Workspace domain sign in (the hd claim).
settings.name: hostedDomain

options.description: Sign in with Microsoft Entra ID (an app registration of the tenant's directory).
options.name: entra

settings.description: The directory (tenant) id.
settings.name: tenantId

settings.description: The application (client) id.
settings.name: clientId

settings.description: The client secret.
settings.name: clientSecret

options.description: Sign in with any OpenID Connect provider.
options.name: oidc

settings.description: The provider's issuer.
settings.name: issuer

settings.description: The discovery document (default <issuer>/.well-known/openid-configuration).
settings.name: discoveryUrl

settings.description: The client id.
settings.name: clientId

settings.description: The client secret.
settings.name: clientSecret

settings.description: The scopes asked for.
settings.name: scopes

settings.description: The ID token claim listing the person's groups.
settings.name: groupsClaim

settings.description: The sign-in button's text.
settings.name: label

settings.description: A PEM CA bundle file trusted besides the public roots (a provider on a private CA).
settings.name: caBundleFile

options.description: Sign in with Pragmatic (the central login as an OpenID Connect upstream).
options.name: pragmatic

settings.description: The client id registered at the central login.
settings.name: clientId

settings.description: The client secret.
settings.name: clientSecret

settings.description: The central realm's issuer (default https://login.pragmatic-tech.ai/realms/central).
settings.name: issuer

settings.description: A PEM CA bundle file trusted besides the public roots (a development central login).
settings.name: caBundleFile

options.description: Google Identity Platform accounts (the central realm): email and password with sign-up and a verified email, Google accounts.
options.name: identityPlatform

settings.description: The Google Cloud project.
settings.name: projectId

settings.description: The browser API key the login page uses (public by design, restricted by referrer and API).
settings.name: apiKey

settings.description: The Identity Platform providers accepted: password, google.com.
settings.name: providers

settings.description: The Identity Platform tenant, when the project uses multi-tenancy.
settings.name: tenantId

settings.description: How old an Identity Platform sign-in may be when the page posts its token.
settings.name: maxAuthAge

settings.description: The Identity Platform auth domain (default <projectId>.firebaseapp.com).
settings.name: authDomain
